mostWorthwhile.text: Following the dense gas collision was most worthwhile: compression, heating and cooling explained why gas behaves differently from the passing stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final cloud placement was the least engaging decision because it was the only gameplay action offered, though its result was informative.

surprise.text: The thin gas formed a hot, diffuse bridge instead of collapsing promptly into stars.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the final placement had a clear destination, even if its outcome was uncertain.

continue.text: Yes. I’d be curious to see how the different gas outcomes lead toward new stars and worlds.
